director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj cricket pitch jaise number line par fractions rakhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
haan

Cricket pitch ko ek number line socho: ek stump 0 par hai aur doosra stump 1 par. Batsman run ke liye bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ke ek pakke spot par khada hai, aur us spot ka bhi ek number hota hai. Badhiya, Riya!
haan samajh gayi
Screen par 0 se 1 ki line hai, aur theek beech mein ek mark. Yeh mark 0 se 1 ko 2 barabar gaps mein baant raha hai, aur is mark ka naam 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe nahi pata
0 se 1 ki line ko 2 barabar gaps mein baanto. Beech wala mark 1/2 hai, aur woh 0 aur 1 ke beech hi hai. Ab isi par ek sawaal.
Hindi mein bolo
Haan, ab se Hindi mein bolti hoon. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/3, 3 ke paas aata hai. 1/3 kahaan hai: isi 0 se 1 wali line par, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: 0 se 1 wali line par

Bilkul, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali rekha par hota hai, kyunki 1/3 ka matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps mein se pehla gap, toh woh isi rekha par hai. Screen par wahi 0 se 1 ki rekha hai, aur rekha ke upar ab beech mein 3 marks hain. Marks nahi, gaps dekho: 4 barabar gaps hain, isliye 0 ke baad pehla mark 1/4 hai. Isi rekha ke neeche ki taraf beech mein 7 marks hain. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Isi rekha ke neeche ki taraf 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 nishaan barabar doori par hain. Neeche ki taraf rekha kitne barabar gaps mein bati hai?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain, 7 + 1 = 8. Screen par 0 se 1 ki rekha ab 8 barabar gaps mein bati hai, toh har gap pehle se chhota gap hai. Pehla nishaan 1/8 hai, bilkul 0 ke paas, aur beech wala nishaan abhi bhi 1/2 hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya
Rekha ke jitne zyada gaps, har gap utna chhota. Isliye 1/8 wala pehla nishaan 0 ke bilkul paas hai. Agar yahi rekha 10 barabar gaps mein bati ho, toh 0 ke zyada paas kaun hoga: 1/5 ya 1/10?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 10 barabar gaps ka har gap 5 gaps wale gap se chhota hai, toh 1/10, 0 ke zyada paas rukta hai. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 km par. Ghar aur school ke beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par lage hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne km door hai? Diya hai: ghar 0 par, school 1 km par, beech mein 3 khambe, barabar doori par. Dhoondhna hai: pehle khambe ki ghar se doori, km mein. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
haan samajh gayi
Pehla kadam dekho. Rekha banao aur ghar ko 0 par, school ko 1 par likho: 0 se 1 tak ki rekha, kyunki 0 se 1 tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi
Ghar ko 0 par aur school ko 1 par rakho. Ghar se school tak ka poora raasta ek poora hai. Chalo, aage dekhte hain.
theek hai
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe nahi, beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe, toh 4 barabar hisse, kyunki beech ke nishaan se gaps hamesha ek zyada hote hain. Ab isse aage chalte hain.
aapko virat pasand hai?
Virat ki batting wali baat yaad rahegi; lesson ke ant mein us par lautenge. Raasta 4 barabar gaps mein bata hai, aur pehla khamba ghar se theek ek gap door hai. Toh pehla khamba kitne km par hai?
